lead.t: Uric acid is an end product of purine metabolism that is excreted by the kidneys

snip.t: Uric acid is an end product of purine metabolism that is excreted by the kidneys

qs.q: A patient with a history of gout is treated with allopurinol. This drug works by inhibiting which enzyme involved in purine metabolism?
qs.e: Allopurinol is a structural analog of hypoxanthine that inhibits xanthine oxidase, reducing uric acid production.
